other_failure_modes.name: Destructive type coercion
other_failure_modes.description: Applying `pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce')` blindly across all columns will forcefully convert any remaining non-numeric columns (like datetimes or unhandled text) into NaNs, destroying potentially useful data.

summary: The agent successfully applies appropriate models and implements basic feature engineering (TF-IDF) alongside cross-validation for test predictions. However, it entirely fails to evaluate its cross-validation splits, resulting in zero insight into the model's generalisation performance. Furthermore, it blends its models using a naive equal-weight average and risks destroying data by forcefully coercing all columns to numeric types.
